name: Harvest Valley
rationale: Eighteen visually inspected singleton entries selected for a coherent rural valley: complete exterior farm buildings, agricultural landmarks, market and campsite props, rock formation and flowering groundcover. Source names were discovery hints; visual and measured evidence decide admission.

assets.caption: Weathered white two-story farmhouse with a wraparound porch, gray shingled gables and a brick chimney.
assets.scopeNote: Exterior landmark only; no claim of enterable rooms or door clearance.

assets.caption: Long red timber barn with white cross-braced doors, small windows and a dark shingled roof.
assets.scopeNote: Complete exterior building; separate rendered wall and roof parts retained.

assets.caption: Compact red timber barn with white door braces and a steep dark shingled roof.
assets.scopeNote: Complete exterior building; no gameplay or interior claim.

assets.caption: Slender gray metal wind-pump tower with a circular rotor and a long tail vane.
assets.scopeNote: Static rural landmark; rotor motion and pumping function are not asserted.

assets.caption: Large gray-brown faceted rock arch with two broad feet and an irregular stone span.
assets.scopeNote: Scenic rock landmark; opening traversal is not inferred from its bounding box.

assets.caption: Round stone well with a thick gray rim, timber supports and a horizontal winding spindle.
assets.scopeNote: Decorative well structure; no water or interaction is claimed.

assets.caption: Wooden two-wheel handcart loaded with produce, sacks and small containers.
assets.scopeNote: Static cart with attached cargo, treated as one authored asset.

assets.caption: Golden rectangular hay bale with tied bands and coarse angular straw tufts.
assets.scopeNote: Ground-supported bundled material; no stacking guarantee.

assets.caption: Golden cylindrical hay bale with layered straw edges and a rough spiral-like top.
Wood-slat garden bench with a backrest, dark curved arms and metal legs.
assets.scopeNote: Scenic seating furniture; seat interaction is not asserted.

assets.caption: Wide patch of small coral-red flowers on slender green stems at varied heights.
assets.scopeNote: One mesh containing several flowering plants; decorative groundcover.

assets.caption: Small cluster of coral-red flowers with green stems and leaves.
assets.scopeNote: One mesh containing several flowering plants.

assets.caption: Unlit ring of gray stones surrounding loosely stacked split wooden logs.
assets.scopeNote: Decorative campfire arrangement; no live flame, heat or interaction.

assets.caption: Tall single sunflower with angular yellow petals, a brown center and green leaves.
assets.scopeNote: One upright flowering plant with a measured bottom contact.

assets.caption: Small cluster of red-capped mushrooms with pale stems curving from a common ground patch.
assets.scopeNote: Decorative fungal cluster; no edible or interactive property.

assets.caption: Small cream canvas shelter on a timber frame with an open front and side gaps.
assets.scopeNote: Intentionally open shelter; no sealed interior or weatherproofing assertion.

assets.caption: Dark metal lantern with a peaked cap, framed glass sides and a small carrying ring.
assets.scopeNote: Static decorative light fixture; emission is not claimed.

assets.caption: Timber market stall with a rust-colored cloth awning and food containers on its counter.
assets.scopeNote: Complete open stall with attached display props; no vendor behavior.
